Want to be happy? Care, but not that much.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a negotiation seminar where the teacher, Herb Cohen, smoked a cigar in a non-smoking room because he had negotiated the right to. His rule for negotiating: care, but not that much.

Then the teacher said life works the same way. To be happy, you have to care, but not that much.

Kevin says that is what letting go really means. It is not giving up, it is living in a state of allowing.

Where in your life are you caring too much?
